review_evidence: README describes a pure Lean implementation of RFC 4648 Base64 encoding/decoding and URL-safe encoding.

Complete scan of the primary Lean sources found no theorem, lemma, axiom, or proposition-example declarations; Base64/Encode.lean and Base64/Decode.lean consist of executable encoder/decoder definitions.
The repository tests behavior but does not state or prove round-trip, RFC-conformance, encoder/decoder-correctness, or other independent formal semantics properties.

source_action.content_invariant: Its primary Lean files implement Base64 operations and test infrastructure but contain no theorem/lemma/axiom/proposition-example declarations or independently proved Base64 specification; retirement removes no mathematical theorem/proof or formal-specification corpus.
